verdict.rationale: The pack shows preset-configuration features: a custom-branded client generator, 90+ configurable options, centralized settings in paid tiers, and a community note that the Windows .exe filename can point the client at a server. None of it documents mass deployment through MSI packages, MDM profiles, or a documented silent/unattended install. Those are adjacent features, not the deployment capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
